blurb: @runaway_vol is Blair Dulder, a CPA who self-identifies as the top-ranked inflation trader on Kalshi, a CFTC-regulated prediction-market exchange where participants bet on macroeconomic outcomes such as monthly CPI prints. Despite the volatility-trading connotations of the handle, Dulder's disclosed edge is macroeconomic rather than options-specific: he describes his approach as reading BLS and Fed releases carefully. He is also building markets.sh and perchpad, both early-stage fintech projects. His X posting style is irreverent, self-aware, and aphoristic — mixing genuine market commentary with humor and motivational one-liners. The account has approximately 14,000 followers and was created in April 2012.
credibility_note: Dulder's claim to be the #1 inflation trader on Kalshi is self-reported and unverified from primary sources; Kalshi does not publish public leaderboards for individual market categories. His CPA credential is plausible given the handle's accounting-adjacent humor, but is also unverified. His posting style includes a mix of substantive market commentary and performative brevity — the latter genre makes specific claims difficult to evaluate. Treat individual trade calls and performance claims as unaudited.
